title: Prompt injection in AI grading allows students to self-award full marks
impact: Student answers are interpolated with unescaped double quotes into the same user prompt above INSTRUCTIONS in both src/lib/ai/grading.ts and functions/src/grading.ts, allowing a crafted submission to override grading instructions and return score 10.
recommendation: Move grader instructions and rubric into Gemini systemInstruction, isolate student submissions in escaped XML tags, and enforce output structure with generationConfig.responseSchema.
note: RT-07 merged: systemInstruction, per-request delimiters, schema validator and injection heuristic route to pending_review (table-driven tests in grading-hardening.test.ts).

title: billingContext exemption for landing and research suppresses budget errors and allows uncapped Gemini spend (also C-002, G-005)
impact: When LANDING_ORG_ID is unset or exhausts its aiBudgetLimit, callGeminiDirect catches and ignores budgetErr for landing/research types; combined with client-generated visitorId strings in /api/chat/landing, attackers can bypass the 10-message demo cap and drain GEMINI_API_KEY without bound.
recommendation: Do not suppress budgetErr when LANDING_ORG_ID hits its budget cap, enforce a server-signed visitor token or App Check on /api/chat/landing, and use a transaction for landing_visitors messageCount.
note: RT-03 merged: landing fails closed with signed cookie, daily cap and 512-token cap, but route returns 503 until the owner sets LANDING_VISITOR_COOKIE_SECRET and LANDING_ORG_ID budget.

title: Unterminated pending AI budget reservations on transport timeouts permanently leak aiUsageReserved (also B-003)
impact: When fetch times out (60s) or usageMetadata is missing, settleBudget is not called and ai_reservations remains pending forever because no reconciliation job exists, permanently inflating organizations.aiUsageReserved until the network is locked out of AI.
recommendation: Release or settle reservations in a try/finally handler on transport failure, and add a scheduled Cloud Function to expire pending ai_reservations older than 5 minutes.
note: RT-04 merged: failed provider calls settle an estimate and expireStaleReservations sweeps holds after 30 min, but the ai_reservations (status, createdAt) index must be deployed by the owner.

title: Cloud Functions grading triggers use default 60s timeout against a 15-minute lock lease and sequential Vertex AI calls
impact: onSubmissionCreated and onSubmissionUpdated inherit the 60s v2 default timeout while acquiring a 15-minute grading_locks lease and grading questions sequentially; a >60s run kills the container before finally can delete the lock or set pending_review, leaving the submission stuck and locked for 15 minutes.
recommendation: Set timeoutSeconds: 300 and memory: '512MiB' on the grading triggers and grade questions with bounded concurrency and per-call timeouts.
note: RT-05 merged: 540s timeout and 1GiB on both triggers, concurrency 3, lease 10 min, sweepStuckGrading; the sweep needs the submissions (status, submittedAt) index deployed.

title: No CI/CD workflows: nothing runs typecheck, lint, unit tests, rules tests or build before deploy (also E-010)

note: RT-08 merged: ci.yml runs typecheck, jest, security, build, gitleaks, but the owner must require the checks in branch protection (eslint/audit are non-blocking, no dependabot).

title: Student Notebook Copilot attempts client-side updateDoc on users/{uid}.aiUsageCount, triggering PERMISSION_DENIED on every query

title: Missing allow update rule on /assignments/{id} breaks teacher assignment visibility toggles and edits
impact: firestore.rules only defines allow read, create, delete on /assignments/{id} (with allow update default-denied), causing updateDoc(doc(db, 'assignments', id), { visibility }) in src/app/teacher/assignments/page.tsx:L130 to fail with PERMISSION_DENIED whenever a teacher shares an assignment to Waypoints.
recommendation: Add allow update: if isSignedIn() && isOwner(resource.data.teacherId) && request.resource.data.teacherId == resource.data.teacherId; to match /assignments/{id} in firestore.rules.
note: RT-14 merged: visibility-only update rule for assignment owners plus toast, tested in rules emulator; firestore.rules must be deployed by the owner.

title: Unbounded client writes and document-ID squatting on notebooks and tutor_sessions collections
impact: allow create on notebooks and tutor_sessions neither restricts document IDs nor enforces org notebookLimitPerStudent quotas or payload schemas, while allow read, delete: if id == request.auth.uid lets an attacker pre-create notebooks/<victimUid> with malicious content that is automatically migrated into the victim's notebooks on first visit (src/app/student/notebook/page.tsx:L182-L198).
recommendation: Remove id == request.auth.uid from notebooks/tutor_sessions rules, prevent creating docs with id == request.auth.uid, validate schema and size bounds on create/update, and enforce notebookLimitPerStudent via a server API route.
note: RT-14 merged: id squatting closed and key/size allow-lists added, but per-student notebook limit is still not enforced server-side and rules must be deployed by the owner.

title: Self-update rule on /users/{id} allows changing email to an unverified address used by Cloud Functions for Resend email delivery
impact: A user can update their own users/{uid}.email field to any victim's email address because email is not excluded in the affectedKeys() deny-list, and onAssignmentCreated (functions/src/index.ts:L99) sends Resend assignment notifications directly to student.email.
recommendation: Require (!request.resource.data.diff(resource.data).affectedKeys().hasAny(['email']) || request.resource.data.email == request.auth.token.email) in the /users/{id} update rule.
note: RT-14 merged: users.email writable only when equal to the token email; firestore.rules must be deployed by the owner.
